# Setup checklist — Sunrise Family Clinic

Generated by `npm run build -- demo-clinic`. Tick each box during the delivery call.

## 1. Accounts (in the CLINIC's name)
- [ ] n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) — timezone Asia/Kolkata
- [ ] Google account owning the Sheet `DEMO_SHEET_ID_paste_real_id_here`
- [ ] Meta Business + WhatsApp Business Platform, phone number id `DEMO_PHONE_NUMBER_ID`

## 2. Google Sheet
- [ ] Tab **Appointments** with header row (exact): `appointment_id,patient_name,phone,doctor,appt_date,appt_time,visit_type,status,payment_status,amount_paid,payment_mode,follow_up_date,whatsapp_consent,last_reminder_date,booked_on`
- [ ] Columns E, F, L, N, O formatted **Plain text** (Format → Number → Plain text)
- [ ] Tab **Dashboard** with the formulas from `sheet-template/dashboard-formulas.md`
- [ ] Shared only with clinic staff (no public link)

## 3. n8n credentials (names must match)
- [ ] Google Sheets OAuth2 → `Google Sheets (clinic)`
- [ ] Gmail OAuth2 → `Gmail (alerts)`
- [ ] Header Auth → `WhatsApp Cloud API`: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <permanent system-user token>`
- [ ] OpenAI API credential (AI receptionist)

## 4. Import / deploy
- [ ] Easiest: `N8N_URL=… N8N_API_KEY=… npm run deploy -- demo-clinic` (creates/updates all, links error workflow + AI tools)
- [ ] Or import manually in this order:
  - `workflows/00-error-handler.json` → Sunrise · 0 · Error Handler
  - `workflows/01-book-appointment.json` → Sunrise · 1 · Book Appointment
  - `workflows/02-reminders.json` → Sunrise · 2 · WhatsApp Reminders
  - `workflows/02b-same-day-reminders.json` → Sunrise · 2b · Same-day Reminders
  - `workflows/03-visit-update.json` → Sunrise · 3 · Visit Update
  - `workflows/04-daily-report.json` → Sunrise · 4 · Daily Report
  - `workflows/06-razorpay-advance-fee.json` → Sunrise · 6 · Razorpay Advance Fee
  - `workflows/08-booking-engine-ai-tools.json` → Sunrise · 8 · Booking Engine (AI tools)
  - `workflows/07-whatsapp-ai-receptionist.json` → Sunrise · 7 · WhatsApp AI Receptionist
- [ ] Open each workflow, fix any node showing a credential warning
- [ ] Every workflow: Settings → Error workflow = "Sunrise · 0 · Error Handler"

## 5. URLs to hand over (after activating)
- Booking form: `<n8n-url>/form/demo-clinic-book`
- Visit update form: `<n8n-url>/form/demo-clinic-visit`
- Razorpay webhook: `<n8n-url>/webhook/demo-clinic-razorpay`
- WhatsApp AI webhook: `<n8n-url>/webhook/demo-clinic-whatsapp` (verify token `verify-444230d5ac8a55b77956`)

## 6. Configuration summary
- Doctors: Dr. Mehta (10:00-13:00, 17:00-20:00; closed Sunday; 1/slot); Dr. Rao (17:00-20:00; closed Sunday/Thursday; 1/slot)
- Slot length: 15 min → 24 slots in the form dropdown
- Reminders: 0 18 * * * + same-day 2h before
- Daily report: 0 21 * * * → doctor@example.com
- Optional features on: booking_confirmation_whatsapp, doctor_report_whatsapp, razorpay_advance_fee, ai_whatsapp_assistant

## 7. Test before go-live
- [ ] Run `docs/04-testing-checklist.md` on a COPY of the sheet with your own numbers
